categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Nanwang Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the paper and paper products industry, focusing on the research, manufacturing, and sales of environmentally friendly paper bags, food packaging, non-woven fabric bags, labels, and receipt paper. The company also engages in the production of various types of paper packaging products including paper cups, paper bowls, and paper straws, serving sectors such as retail, food service, and consumer goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including automated production lines, 5G-enabled smart factories, AI and industrial robotics for quality control and efficiency improvements. It uses water-based inks and adhesives for eco-friendly paper bags, and develops proprietary technologies for low-weight oil-resistant packaging and non-waterproof functional coatings. The firm integrates MES, WMS, and APS systems for digitalized production and logistics management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nanwang serves leading domestic and international brands in fast food, retail, apparel, and beverage sectors, including KFC, McDonald's, Starbucks, Meituan, Nike, Adidas, and Heytea. Its products cater to consumer goods packaging, food service packaging, e-commerce logistics, and commercial labeling markets, focusing on environmentally sustainable packaging solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Fujian, Guangdong, Anhui, Hubei, Hebei, and Shanghai. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in Malaysia, Canada, and Indonesia, targeting North American and Southeast Asian markets to mitigate trade barriers and capture emerging market growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanwang operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying paper-based packaging products and related materials. It manages procurement of raw materials, production, and distribution, serving downstream brand customers and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in sustainable packaging materials and production technologies, including development of 100% recycled pulp labels, heat-resistant thermal labels, and non-woven fabric bags with insulation properties. It invests in smart factory technologies integrating AI, 5G, and robotics to enhance automation and quality control. R&D collaborations with universities and equipment suppliers support continuous product and process innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Nanwang generates revenue primarily through product sales of paper packaging, non-woven bags, labels, and receipt paper. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, with a focus on fulfilling large-scale contracts with major brand customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in the environmentally friendly paper bag segment within China’s packaging industry. It competes with other packaging manufacturers in the paper and printing sectors, leveraging scale, technology, and strong customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages. Its international expansion aims to strengthen its position against global competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Nanwang reported consolidated revenues of approximately RMB 1.4 billion, representing a 21.77% increase over the prior year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 37.28 million, with a decline compared to 2023 due to increased costs and investments. The company has expanded its asset base and production capacity, including a new smart factory with annual output exceeding 2.2 billion units, supporting sustained growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanwang differentiates itself through its commitment to environmentally sustainable packaging solutions using high-quality recycled materials and advanced eco-friendly production processes. Its smart factory capabilities enable high precision, consistent quality, and cost efficiency. The company’s strong brand partnerships and comprehensive product range, including innovative thermal and functional packaging, provide integrated solutions that enhance customer value and loyalty.
